create_CTC_distribution: create a CTC distribution from log potentials, labels, label lengths, input lengths, and blank id
test_CTC_loss_against_optax: test the CTC loss and log partition functions match between optax and non-optax implementations
test_alignment_to_labels: test converting top-k alignments to labels using the alignment_to_labels method
run_CTC_loss: run the CTC loss computation on a batched distribution with optional optax backend
run_CTC_log_partition: run the log partition function on a CTC distribution with optional optax backend
